answer: Sealed-manifest commit-reveal stops bulk fakes: each identity seals its jobs into the river log, locks 80 credits, pays 45. At the summit auditors re-hash the revealed manifest and require receipts from three clients. A canyon between sealed hash and revealed work burns the bond and bars manifest reuse. 1,000 fakes pay 125 each, 125,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented manifests fail on key mismatch; honest agents pay 45 once, keep a full share.
